behavior: A trigger that has focus guards beside its element has one root node. A rule of `<style scoped>`, `v-show`, a custom directive and `<Transition>` of the consumer thus apply to the element of the trigger, also while the guards are in the document. A portal part has one root node too, its `Teleport`, also while the portal keeps its focus guards and its owner element beside it. With Vue 3.5.41 or later, a `<Transition>` of the consumer thus applies to the portal element.
